We are looking for candidates interested in a PhD position on rethinking videoconferencing in on-the-go contexts when using mobile devices.

The PhD will be conducted within the MINT research group at the CRIStAL laboratory, University of Lille, France and co-supervised by the IIHM research group at the LIG laboratory, University Grenoble Alpes, France. The candidate will benefit from the complementary expertise of both groups, with opportunities for regular exchanges and research visits between Lille and Grenoble. More details about the position can be found in the attached document.

The PhD will be supervised by Yosra Rekik (yosra.rekik@univ-lille.fr) and Laurence Nigay (laurence.nigay@univ-grenoble-alpes.fr).

Please do not hesitate to contact us if you are interested or have any questions. The application deadline is April 30.

Laurence will attend CHI 2026 in Barcelona this week. If you will also be there and are interested in the position, feel free to reach out by email, Laurence would be happy to discuss the opportunity in person.
